profiles.title: Isolated RimTest load and gameplay smoke

procedures.title: RimTest isolated mod build and content-load smoke
steps: Run the supported installed RimTest CLI against the exact Aquaculture candidate workspace using rimtest dev-check <workspace> --json; do not launch RimWorld or deploy assemblies manually.
Require BUILD_PASS, STATIC_PASS, RUNTIME_LOAD_PASS, INFRASTRUCTURE_PASS and CLEANUP_PASS in the structured result; record candidate source identity and the result evidence.
Treat any failed or unavailable stage as BLOCKED or FAIL; a runtime-load pass does not establish pond gameplay, persistence, or UI behavior.

procedures.title: RimTest gameplay and framework smoke
steps: In an approved isolated RimTest/RimLiaison game session, run the Aquaculture affected or smoke suite from TestCatalog/rimtest.catalog.json.
Verify the built/deployed/loaded Aquaculture assembly identities match the exact candidate, and require loadedArtifactFreshnessProven=true.
Exercise real pond, fish population, rod, commission, Knowledge Framework and Deferred Reality paths; record per-test outcomes and controlled lease release.

procedures.title: Live UI accessibility and visual acceptance
steps: After reaching a valid RimLiaison-managed live UI state, inspect semantic targets and targeted screenshots for settings, pond, fish dossier and Journal.
Check wide/medium/narrow layout, density, contrast, reduced motion, focus, scrolling, repeated open/close, and relevant diagnostics.
Record NOT RUN if the required owner-managed bridge session, lease, or visual evidence is unavailable.

procedures.title: Gameplay persistence and compatibility acceptance
steps: In disposable RimTest-owned colonies and saves, exercise save/reload and legacy migration, interrupted rod restoration, natural populations, cross-framework duplicate suppression and multi-map behavior.
Run long-duration pond/population/performance scenarios, inspect bounded logs, and record any unrelated-mod errors separately.
Keep normal player saves and ModsConfig untouched; do not infer a pass from portable tests or a quicktest load.

procedures.title: Clean player package acceptance
steps: Using the existing reviewed Aquaculture release workflow, verify exact-source package assembly hashes, dependencies, generated manifests and the player ZIP allowlist.
Ensure the player ZIP excludes developer source, tools, caches, PDBs, bridge harnesses and duplicate dependency assemblies.
Confirm clean install with required dependencies, without developer bridge tools, and record result for the exact release candidate.
